## 2. Product Categories & Technical Specifications

### Automatic Sliding Gates
- **Ground Track Sliding Gates**:
  - Inverted V or round galvanized steel track embedded into reinforced concrete footings.
  - Machined steel / nylon internal ball-bearing wheels for smooth, silent operation.
  - Top guide rollers with heavy-duty mounting bracket.
- **Cantilever Trackless Sliding Gates**:
  - Zero ground track required; suspended over driveway opening via internal bottom carriage track and counterbalanced tail.
  - Ideal for sloping terrain, gravel driveways, unpaved surfaces, or heavy civil entryways.
- **Telescopic Sliding Gates**:
  - 2-panel or 3-panel synchronized cable-driven sliding gates.
  - Requires half the slide-back clearance compared to standard single sliding gates.

### Automatic Swing Gates
- **Single Swing Gate**: Fabricated up to 4.5m wide with heavy-duty post hinges.
- **Double Swing Gates**: Synchronized dual gate panels with electric lock / magnetic latch options.
- **Bi-Fold Folding Gates**: Articulated fast-opening panels designed for steep uphill driveways or minimal vehicle parking depth.

### Solar Off-Grid Automation
- **System Specs**: High-efficiency 40W–100W monocrystalline solar panels with MPPT smart charge controller.
- **Battery Storage**: Dual 12V 35Ah deep-cycle AGM batteries providing 5–7 days of continuous autonomy during cloudy or rainy weather.
- **Applications**: Acreage properties in Karalee, Greenbank, Jimboomba, Samford Valley, and rural South East Queensland.

### Aluminium Slat Fencing & Privacy Screens
- **Slat Sizes**: 65mm x 16mm, 90mm x 16mm, or custom louvres.
- **Spacing Options**: 0mm (100% full privacy blockout), 9mm, 20mm (standard ~50% council airflow compliant).
- **Finishes**: Genuine Dulux powdercoating (Monument, Surfmist, Basalt, Woodland Grey, Satin Black) or DecoWood natural timber sublimation (Western Red Cedar, Spotted Gum, Bush Cherry).

## 3. Automation Motors & Electronics

| Motor Model | Gate Type | Max Weight | Speed | Duty Cycle | Power Source |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Centurion D5 Smart** | Sliding | 500 kg | Up to 36 m/min | Residential / Light Commercial | 240V Mains or Solar |
| **Centurion D10 Smart** | Sliding | 1,000 kg | Up to 30 m/min | High-Volume Commercial | 240V Mains |
| **Centurion Vantage 400** | Swing (Piston) | 400 kg / leaf | ~14 sec 90° | Residential Double Swing | 240V Mains or Solar |
| **Centurion Vantage 500** | Swing (Piston) | 500 kg / leaf | ~16 sec 90° | Heavy Duty Double Swing | 240V Mains or Solar |
| **Nice Robus 600 / 1000** | Sliding | 600–1000 kg | Variable speed | Residential / Commercial | 240V Mains |

### Safety & Access Hardware
- **Safety**: Infrared anti-crush photo beams, magnetic loop detectors, auto-reverse obstacle sensing.
- **Access Control**: 4G cellular smartphone app openers, wireless weather-resistant PIN keypads, HD video intercoms with night vision, encrypted 128-bit key fobs (100m+ line of sight).

---

## 4. Council Compliance & Pool Safety Standards
- **Front Boundary Fences**: Standard permissible height without building approval is up to 1.5m solid, or up to 1.8m – 2.0m when maintaining at least 50% visual transparency / permeability (Brisbane City Council & Ipswich City Council planning schemes).
- **Pool Fencing (AS 1926.1-2012)**: Minimum 1.2m height from finished ground level, self-closing and self-latching hinges opening outwards from pool area, maximum 100mm ground clearance.

---

## 5. Pricing & Estimation Guidelines (AUD)
- **Custom Sliding Gate (4.0m x 1.8m Aluminium Slat + Centurion Motor)**: ~$4,200 – $5,600 AUD fully fabricated, powdercoated & automated.
- **Double Automated Swing Gate (3.6m x 1.5m)**: ~$4,800 – $6,500 AUD.
- **Off-Grid Solar Package Add-on**: +$1,400 – $1,800 AUD (including solar panel, mounting bracket, dual batteries & MPPT controller).
- **Service / Repair Callout**: $250 AUD (includes diagnosis and on-site motor recalibration).
- **On-Site Laser Measure & CAD Proposal**: 100% FREE across all of Brisbane, Ipswich, Logan, and Gold Coast.
